purpose: Operational evidence for 50-formula pilot and future AI-answer harvesting

process_gates.label: Herleitung und Elimination
process_gates.missing_capability: systematic star/chain motifs; saturation and domain exclusions

process_gates.label: Gegenprobe und Widerlegung
process_gates.missing_capability: automatic numerical/model counterexamples, unit and edge semantic tests

rules: A Python function is not necessarily a validated independent reusable skill.
Candidate adapter families are not implemented skills.
No automatic paper merge without domain and editorial acceptance.
